issues.fix: 09a_econ.js regular-row branch: scale the ct tube x by 0.38 (not 0.55) so it is no wider than the plate (2.1 cm); end it 2 cm inside the plate (last cp y 0.50, z -0.17). End panel: extend the rear sections to z0 -0.08 for y >= 0.47 (zs(0.50, -0.08, -0.40, 0.024), zs(0.525, -0.085, -0.392, 0.024)) and add a lower-rear fillet section zs(0.415, -0.16, -0.33) so the panel's rear edge is the sweep's continuation; optionally lift the panel bottom by ~3 cm over the last 8 cm (front z < -0.32) as in b_ss_18.
